source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αλπέγιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page prints the English form of his name itself, «ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Αλπέγιος (Alphege)», so that form was not transliterated here but copied. It gives 984 as the year of his election to Winchester and twenty-two years as the length of that episcopate before Canterbury, and 1012 as the year of his beheading; only the death year was taken as a date. It names no relic and prints no hymn and no couplet. The corpus holds other archbishops of Canterbury — Laurence, Theodore of Tarsus and Brithwald — and this is not one of them.
